# Agentic Pattern Library: full text

{{ all.size }} patterns by Vikas Goyal. Source: {{ D.base | absolute_url }}

Numbers in worked examples are illustrative, not recommendations. Choose real values from your requirements and make them configurable.

Trade-off scores run from 1 (low) to 5 (high) for latency, cost and complexity, and 1 (weak) to 5 (strong) for reliability.
{% for t in D.tracks %}
